entities.name: Battle of Pitdown
entities.description: Skirmish during the Dark Age on Terisiare where the Ghed and Alsoor armies met and goblins attacked both.

entities.name: Ghed
entities.description: Army that tried to intimidate farms into selling harvests south.

entities.name: Alsoor
entities.description: Army with elven mercenaries from the Shattered Isles doing the same thing for the north.

entities.name: Goblins
entities.description: Third faction that attacked both armies.

entities.name: Jodah
entities.description: Fled to deserted Pitdown, hid from goblin raiders in a Fountain of Youth and gained immortality.

entities.name: Fountain of Youth
entities.description: Fountain in which Jodah hid, gaining immortality.

entities.name: Church of Tal
entities.description: Negotiated the peace that ended the war.

events.summary: The Ghed and Alsoor armies, both pressuring farms over harvests, escalate maneuvers into a full-fledged war.
events.quote: What started as military maneuvers became a full-fledged war.

events.summary: At the Battle of Pitdown, goblins attack both armies and their remnants unite to beat them back.
events.quote: The remnants of the two armies united to beat back the goblins.

events.summary: Fleeing Jodah hides from goblin raiders in a Fountain of Youth and gains immortality.
events.quote: hid from goblin raiders in a Fountain of Youth , gaining immortality

events.summary: A week later the Church of Tal negotiates a peace that ends the war.
events.quote: the war ended after the Church of Tal negotiated a peace
